Track record

What INAS UK has done

Founded in 2015 and a Community Interest Company since 2024, INAS UK has hosted a European programme, run its own conventions in Woolwich and supported flood relief in Nepal — all volunteer-led.

Hosted by INAS UK

6th INAS European Regional Programme

21–22 April 2018 · London, United Kingdom

INAS UK’s first time hosting a European edition — running the 6th European Solo Nepali Dance Competition and the 3rd European Solo Singing Competition. The 2027 programme builds on this with a larger public audience.

See every past programme and its winners →
24–25 April 2026 Chosen to host the 12th European programme An INAS UK delegation took part in the 11th INAS EU Regional Programme in Maldegem, Belgium. INAS UK was selected to host the 12th programme in 2027, confirmed by a letter of authorisation from the INAS Global committee.
2026 Nepal flood relief Raised about Rs 2 lakh from its committee, founders and supporters, giving around 70 flood-affected households in Rasuwa 15 days of food and clothing. Through partnerships — including a Help Nepal UK relief programme and a screening of the film Lakhe — more than Rs 5 lakh has been sent to Nepal for flood relief in total.
26 October 2025 Sixth Convention & Dashain–Tihar programme Held at the Tramshed Theatre, Woolwich, with Nepal’s acting ambassador to the UK, Bipin Duwadi, as chief guest, joined by community leaders from NRN UK. INAS UK honoured 22 writers, artists, film-makers, journalists and community leaders, with songs, madal drumming, dances and a cultural ramp walk in traditional dress. Covered by Onlinekhabar and Nepali Link; about 250 people attended.
11 February 2024 Fifth General Convention Held at the Tramshed, Woolwich, with Nepal’s Ambassador to the UK, His Excellency Gyan Chandra Acharya, as chief guest, joined by Jit Rana Bhat, former Mayor of the Royal Borough of Greenwich. About 250 people attended.
2015 → 2024 Founded and formalised Established in 2015 as the UK national committee of INAS, the worldwide Nepali-artist network founded in 2012. Registered as a Community Interest Company in September 2024, run entirely by volunteers with state committees for England, Scotland and Wales.
